  "categories": [

      "name": "kernel",

      "evidence": "src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp changes are mechanical caller conversions resulting from the CScriptWitness accessor refactor.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates to CScriptWitness call sites do not change kernel API, library boundaries, or standalone validation architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "src/policy/policy.cpp and mempool test updates are mechanical adjustments to the new CScriptWitness span API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change does not alter transaction policy, standardness rules, eviction, or mempool package acceptance."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/node/miner.cpp are mechanical caller conversions from the scripted diff.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify block template generation, mining interfaces, or fee accounting."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates src/net_processing.cpp to drop transactions exceeding block weight or with empty inputs/outputs at the deserialization stage.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.8,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "It eliminates an unauthenticated peer DoS vector by dropping unbounded or malformed transactions at the message deserialization stage before memory is allocated. Unchecked wire messages previously allowed peers to allocate substantial vector memory prior to validation checks."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp solely for CScriptWitness accessor migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change RPC interfaces, output formats, or RPC server performance."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds benchmarks and fuzz targets specifically for block deserialization and script witnesses.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The benchmarks and fuzz targets exercise the new witness serialization implementation rather than modifying testing framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "src/bitcoin-tx.cpp is only touched to adapt to the new CScriptWitness accessor methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No command-line tool logic or developer tooling features are modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/serialize.h and streams add sequence bounds solely to support transaction and witness deserialization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The serialization helpers serve validation and P2P deserialization bounds rather than general utility library improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Redesigns CScriptWitness storage and upfront deserialization limits in src/primitives/transaction.h and src/script/interpreter.cpp.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.85,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "It fixes a critical resource-exhaustion and block-deserialization DoS vulnerability where valid 4 MB blocks can consume over 100 MiB of memory. Author benchmarks demonstrate that memory consumption for worst-case valid blocks drops from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB and deserialization time falls from 279.2 ms to 18.7 ms."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in src/wallet/ and src/psbt.cpp are mechanical conversions to the new span-based witness accessors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect wallet transaction creation, coin selection, fund safety, or wallet database persistence."
    }
  ],
